heroHeadline: Day 964: Knesset Restores 'Massacre' to Oct. 7 Memorial Bill; Hamas Military Succession Vacuum Deepens — 34 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 28, 2026 (Day 964 / Ceasefire Day 231): Knesset panel restored the word 'massacre' to the October 7 Memorial Day bill after public backlash over its earlier removal. On the same day, Hamas-affiliated media held funerals for Imad Aslim (Hamas Gaza City brigade deputy commander) and Izz al-Din Beck (Hamas northern Gaza brigade commander), both killed in IDF strikes on May 27 — on top of the Odeh killing that same day. No new Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades supreme commander has been announced; Hamas's military succession is in deep crisis. The Gaza Government Media Office has now documented 3,005+ Israeli ceasefire violations since October 10, 2025 (Ceasefire Day 231). 34 days remain until the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 accountability deadline. The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill — stripped of 'independent investigation' language and barring judges — is advancing toward its first full Knesset plenum reading. The Beyachad alliance (Bennett-Lapid) pledges an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Bloomberg, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post, Washington Post, Al Jazeera, WSJ, and institutional analyses. May 26 (Day 962): 36 days to Supreme Court deadline; Knesset prepares Kallner bill first plenum reading; Phase Two deadlock continues. May 21 (Day 957): Board of Peace presents UNSC report; Hamas named 'principal obstacle' to Phase Two. May 16 (Day 952): IDF kills al-Haddad — last October 7 architect.
